fact: On 3 December 2025 the Kasaï governor launched digitalisation of collection of provincial taxes and fees through Kodinet with Equity BCDC, run through the provincial revenue directorate DGRKAS.
title: Kasaï : la digitalisation du système de perception des recettes provinciales lancée à Tshikapa
